review_evidence: LeanInk/Analysis/InfoTreeTraversal.lean, Analysis/DataTypes.lean, Analysis/LeanContext.lean, and Analysis/SemanticToken.lean implement source-analysis and semantic-token interfaces over Lean elaboration data.
LeanInk/Annotation/Alectryon.lean, Annotation/DataTypes.lean, CLI, FileHelper, and Configuration provide reusable annotation and tooling interfaces.

test/playground/Function.lean proves composition, injectivity, surjectivity, bijectivity, and inverse-function results, and test/theorem_proving contains concrete theorem scripts; those paths therefore carry formal prior-art signal.
summary: Retain LeanInk because its analysis and annotation modules define reusable Lean source/InfoTree tooling, while its test corpus contains concrete formal definitions and theorem-proving examples.
